Hi Sarah —

Sorry we missed each other earlier this morning. I know schedules can get tight — appreciate you getting back to me. Quick recap from our discovery notes so we’re aligned:

- Use case: ACME wants to integrate LLM-based summarization and reranking into the support portal for triage and suggested KB articles.
- Key constraints: PII filtering, SLA for <200ms median token latency for short queries, and SOC2/audit evidence for data handling.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in average time-to-resolution on pilot queues; <5% user-visible quality regression.

Next step we recommended on the call: 45-minute technical deep dive + demo with one of our solutions engineers to validate integration patterns, discuss quantization/latency tradeoffs, and review the POC scope. Dylan is cc'ed and will join the demo.

Would any of these times work for your team (PT)?
- Tue, Jul 28 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT

- Thu, Jul 30 — 9:00–9:45 AM PT
